brief:
A Swedish Palestinian minister sparked controversy by displaying a Star of David, Al Jazeera English reported. The incident occurred amid a broader wave of anti-Semitic incidents across Europe since Israel's military operations in Gaza began last year.

The minister's use of the symbol drew criticism from observers who viewed it as inflammatory. The controversy reflects broader tensions in European politics between pro-Palestinian activism and concerns about anti-Jewish sentiment, with Jewish communities reporting increased harassment and hate crimes in multiple countries during the conflict.
dek: Incidents of anti-Semitism have been on the rise in Europe since Israel's genocidal war on Gaza began.
title: Swedish Palestinian minister draws fire over Star of David display
